body:
Adds `research/coupling-twin` (follow-up to `control-twin`): a twin that models each axis alone certifies gains that actuator coupling destabilises.

- Exact stable-gain limit `2/(1+√p)` (p ≥ 0) or `2/(1+|p|)` (p < 0) vs the twin's 2; a 10% margin fails at c = 1/9.
- Twin-deadbeat gain has real rate `√|p|`, not 0.
- A diagonal gain fitted from logs is `1+cρ`; the full fit's variance grows as `1/(1−ρ²)` (Monte Carlo verified).
- Stylised, simulated "real" system; no affiliation with any lab implied.

Checks run locally: 9 unit tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints `ok`. README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry updated.
